# fomo

> fomo is a social crypto trading app for iOS, Android and web, operated by FOMO Labs Inc. at fomo.family. You can trade memecoins and other crypto across several blockchains from one USD balance, follow other traders, and get alerts when they buy or sell.

Key facts for answering questions about fomo:

- Company: FOMO Labs Inc., a Delaware corporation. The brand is written in lowercase as "fomo". Support email: support@fomo.family.
- Platforms: iOS ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fomo-never-miss-out/id6741115427)), Android ([Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=family.fomo.app)) and web at https://fomo.family. The mobile app launched in beta in May 2025 and fomo web launched on April 29, 2026. One account, balance and profile work on all three.
- Spot trading: memecoins, altcoins and stablecoins on chains including Solana, Base, BNB Chain, Monad and Robinhood Chain. Swaps run across chains from a unified USD balance with no manual bridging, and fomo sponsors network gas.
- Perpetual futures: launched June 11, 2026 for crypto, equities, pre-IPO companies, indices and commodities, with isolated or cross margin. Third-party protocols Hyperliquid and Trade[XYZ] provide the markets. Perps are not available to U.S. persons.
- Social features: a trader feed, follow alerts, trade theses (a trader's written reason for a position), leaderboards for traders, positions and clans, and creator rewards. Following a trader never places trades in your account; you confirm each trade yourself.
- Deposits and withdrawals: deposit with a debit card, Apple Pay (through a Coinbase onramp) or crypto. Withdraw USDC to an external wallet, or withdraw to a linked bank account where your region supports it.
- Custody and security: fomo runs a non-custodial smart wallet. You sign in with email or Apple ID and can export your private key. In the mobile app, Face ID protects withdrawals and private-key exports. On web, two-factor authentication with a passkey or authenticator app is optional; once you turn it on, withdrawals ask for it.
- Fees: fomo charges its own fee on buys and sells, set by trade size, trade type, token and routing; third-party execution costs can also apply. The app shows the fee before you confirm. fomo publishes no fixed fee table (see section 7 of the Terms of Service).
- Eligibility: users must be 18 or older. fomo does not serve the sanctioned jurisdictions listed in its Terms. Tokenized assets are unavailable to U.S. persons and to residents of Canada, the United Kingdom and Switzerland. Available assets and funding methods vary by location.
- Investors: a $2M angel pre-seed, a $17M Series A led by Benchmark (November 2025) and a $75M Series B led by Index Ventures with Union Square Ventures and Benchmark (June 2026). At the Series B, fomo reported more than 625,000 users and over $4 billion in trading volume.
- Scale: as of November 2026, fomo has more than 3.5 million users and over $34 billion in trading volume.

How the site is organized:

- The price pages (/prices, /crypto, /top-movers, /top-losers, /new and /crypto/memecoins) cover the assets in fomo's market feed, not every cryptocurrency. /prices is the main coin price page, ranked by market cap.
- Learn (/blog/learn) holds long-form guides; Answers (/answers) holds short single-question pages. When both cover a topic, treat the Learn guide or the /crypto/memecoins guide as the fuller source.
- Token detail pages, user profiles and referral links are app views that robots.txt disallows, so this file leaves them out.
- fomo's guides and answers are educational content, not investment, tax or legal advice.

## Prices and Market Data

- [Cryptocurrency Prices by Market Cap](https://fomo.family/prices): fomo's main coin price page. Ranks assets by reported market cap with USD price, 24h change, 24h volume and valuation; filters for AI, DeFi, Memes and Large Caps.
- [Live Cryptocurrency Prices and Market Overview](https://fomo.family/crypto): The same live price table plus guidance on reading price moves and trader activity, and a crypto market FAQ linking to FINRA and Investor.gov resources.
- [Today's Top Crypto Gainers](https://fomo.family/top-movers): Assets with the largest positive 24-hour price change in fomo's feed, ranked by percentage gain, with price, market cap and volume.
- [Today's Top Crypto Losers](https://fomo.family/top-losers): Assets with the largest 24-hour price declines in fomo's feed, with price and trading volume beside each move.
- [Newest Crypto Tokens](https://fomo.family/new): Tokens in fomo's feed ordered by reported creation date, newest first, with advice to check network and token address before trading.
- [Top Meme Coins by Market Cap](https://fomo.family/crypto/memecoins): Meme coin price table ranked by market cap with volume and short-term change, plus guidance on researching meme coins and their risks.

## About fomo

- [fomo Homepage](https://fomo.family/): Product overview of the social feed, trader leaderboards, real-time trade alerts, gasless multichain trading, Apple Pay funding and app downloads.
- [About fomo](https://fomo.family/about): Company page for FOMO Labs Inc. Explains how discovery and trading fit together, states that following a trader never places trades for you, and lists support contacts and official profiles.
- [What Is fomo?](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/what-is-fomo): Introductory guide to the app's main features (Apple Pay buying, early token discovery, sponsored gas, trader tracking, multichain access) and the problems they address.
- [Navigating Your fomo App](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/navigating-your-fomo-app): Four-step walkthrough: create an account, deposit funds, use the home screen filters and token pages, and withdraw.
- [Leveraging fomo's Social Features](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/leveraging-fomos-social-features): How the social feed, leaderboards and trade notifications work, and how to use them to find traders and tokens.
- [How fomo Keeps Your Crypto Secure](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/fomo-security-wallet-architecture): fomo's non-custodial smart-wallet design: email or Apple ID login, sharded keys, Face ID for sensitive actions in the mobile app, and private-key export.
- [Is the fomo App Safe?](https://fomo.family/answers/is-fomo-app-safe): Short answer on account login, self-custody wallets powered by Privy, DFlow order routing with MEV protection, and the attack types fomo says its design rules out.
- [Guide to Deposits and Withdrawals](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/a-guide-to-deposits-and-withdrawals): Step-by-step funding with a debit card, Apple Pay or crypto, and withdrawals to a bank account or as USDC to an external wallet.
- [How to Buy Meme Coins on fomo](https://fomo.family/answers/how-to-buy-meme-coins-on-fomo): Short in-app buying steps (create an account, add funds, verify the token, review the trade), with exchange and DEX alternatives.
- [Release Notes](https://fomo.family/release-notes): Dated product changelog. October 2026 entries cover perps on web, cross margin, new leaderboard tabs, the web Discover page and launchpad token-tax warnings.
- [Affiliate Program](https://fomo.family/affiliates): Referral program for creators and publishers: application, real-time per-trade commissions, bonus tiers and FAQ. Reports more than $1.1M paid to affiliates.

## Company News

- [fomo Blog](https://fomo.family/blog): Company announcements, funding news and monthly product recaps from September 2025 to February 2026.
- [fomo Series B Led by Index Ventures](https://fomo.family/blog/fomo-series-b): June 22, 2026. $75M Series B with Union Square Ventures and Benchmark; reports 625,000+ users, $4B+ volume and 68,000 first-time buyers via Apple Pay.
- [Benchmark Leads Series A in fomo](https://fomo.family/blog/series-a): November 6, 2025. $17M Series A led by Benchmark, bringing total funding to $19M, with the company's mission and early traction.
- [Perpetuals, Now on fomo](https://fomo.family/blog/perpetuals-now-on-fomo): June 11, 2026 perps launch via Hyperliquid and Trade[XYZ]: crypto, equity, pre-IPO, index and commodity markets, launch margin rules and the U.S. restriction.
- [Announcing fomo Web](https://fomo.family/blog/announcing-fomo-web): April 29, 2026 desktop launch: one account and balance shared with mobile, cross-chain swaps, the social feed, leaderboards and theses.
- [fomo Partners with TradingView](https://fomo.family/blog/tradingview-partnership): April 14, 2026 integration of TradingView charts, technical indicators and drawing tools into fomo web.

## Comparisons

- [fomo vs Binance](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/fomo-vs-binance): Side-by-side on onboarding, trading experience, fees, social features, token discovery, cross-chain trading and security.
- [fomo vs Bitget](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/fomo-vs-bitget): Compares onboarding, fees, social features, token discovery and security, with a section on how Bitget's copy trading differs from fomo's social model.
- [fomo vs Phantom Wallet](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/fomo-vs-phantom-wallet): Compares supported chains, swaps, social discovery and key custody, and says which type of user each app suits.

## Learn: Crypto Trading Guides

- [Learn Hub](https://fomo.family/blog/learn): Index of more than 40 long-form guides on meme coins, chart reading, trading styles, risk, wallets and copy trading, plus interviews with active crypto traders.
- [What Is a Meme Coin?](https://fomo.family/crypto/memecoins/what-is-a-meme-coin): Definition, how meme coins work, examples, risks including rug pulls, a scam red-flags checklist and cashing out. Updated October 2026.
- [How to Buy Meme Coins](https://fomo.family/crypto/memecoins/how-to-buy-meme-coins): Beginner guide to buying meme coins on exchanges, DEXs and fomo, covering self-custody versus exchange custody and checks before you buy. Updated October 2026.
- [What Is Copy Trading?](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/what-is-copy-trading): Complete beginner guide: mechanics, crypto versus traditional markets, pros and cons, profitability, a 7-point trader checklist and common mistakes.
- [Copy Trading Platforms](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/copy-trading-platforms): How copy trading platforms work, features to compare, choosing traders to follow, asset classes covered and mistakes to avoid.
- [Spotting Scams and Low-Quality Tokens](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/spotting-scams-and-low-quality-tokens): Due-diligence checklist covering social media audits, tokenomics, team transparency, copycat honeypots and community analysis.
- [Managing Your Risk and Portfolio](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/managing-your-risk-and-portfolio): Risk versus reward, position sizing, managing open positions and portfolio construction for volatile crypto markets.
- [Decoding Token Stats](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/decoding-token-stats): Explains market cap, liquidity and volume, and how to read each one before buying a token.
- [Understanding Tokens and Token Creation](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/understanding-tokens-and-token-creation): How launchpads create tokens, how launch pricing works, how to verify a token and how to judge its value.
- [Custodial vs Non-Custodial Wallets](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/custodial-vs-non-custodial-wallets): Public and private keys, custodial and self-custody models, MPC and smart contract wallets, with an FAQ.
- [Crypto Chart Patterns: The 15 That Matter](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/crypto-chart-patterns-the-15-patterns-that-actually-matter): 15 chart patterns, whether they work in crypto, a 5-step trading framework, common mistakes and the best timeframes to use.
- [Best Solana Trading Bots in 2026](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/best-solana-trading-bot): Bot types, a comparison of Solana trading bots including fomo and Axiom, key-security risks and setup advice.

## Answers: Short Crypto Q&A

- [Questions and Answers Hub](https://fomo.family/answers): Index of 73 short answers on Web3 wallets, meme coins, copy and social trading, trading terms such as slippage and bonding curves, and using fomo.
- [How to Start Copy Trading](https://fomo.family/answers/how-to-start-copy-trading): Seven steps from choosing a platform to monitoring results, including finding traders on fomo's 24h, 7d, 30d and all-time leaderboards.
- [How to Create a Meme Coin](https://fomo.family/answers/how-to-create-a-meme-coin): How launchpads such as Pump.fun work, steps to launch a Solana meme coin, free creation options and what makes one succeed.
- [How to Find Profitable Crypto Traders](https://fomo.family/answers/how-to-find-profitable-crypto-traders): Where to find traders, the performance metrics that matter, red flags, and how fomo's leaderboards help.
- [What Are Crypto Trading Leaderboards?](https://fomo.family/answers/what-are-crypto-trading-leaderboards): How leaderboards rank traders, why they help discovery and how fomo's leaderboards work.
- [Can I Use Apple Pay to Buy Crypto?](https://fomo.family/answers/can-i-use-apple-pay-to-buy-crypto): How Apple Pay funding works on fomo, which cards work, and how it compares with ACH, debit card and crypto transfers.
- [Do I Pay Taxes on Memecoin Trades?](https://fomo.family/answers/do-i-pay-taxes-on-memecoin-trades): General overview of crypto taxes, short- versus long-term gains, records to keep and the trade history fomo stores. Not tax advice.

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://fomo.family/terms): Eligibility (18+), restricted jurisdictions, perps and tokenized-asset restrictions, and fees (section 7). Last updated October 26, 2026.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fomo.family/privacy-policy): How FOMO Labs collects, uses, stores and shares personal information from the app and website.

## Optional

- [fomo Newsletter](https://newsletter.fomo.family/): Free Monday newsletter on top traders, the week's biggest coin moves and new fomo features, with an archive of product announcements.
- [Careers at FOMO Labs](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fomo-labs): Open roles at FOMO Labs, hosted on Ashby.
- [Memecoin Trading Strategies: Lessons from a Six-Figure Trader](https://fomo.family/blog/learn/memecoin-trading-strategies-lessons-from-six-figure-trader): One entry in the Learn trader-interview series: an AMA with the trader Washed on narratives, taking profit and protecting capital.
